config.sample_rule: positions 301-600 in the original SHA256(experiment_id + ':' + ticker) ordering of the full historical universe union
config.sample_scope: Same fixed second historical ticker sample for momentum and equal-weight controls
config.scanner_execution: DISABLED; registry recorded only, no scanner comparisons in replication
config.selection: Use decision-time data only; fix intended weights before checking entry/outcome availability
config.identity: Require bar/member ID agreement at decision; features stay inside contiguous same-ticker same-ID segments, breaking at known dated membership conflicts; every holding-session identity must agree. Dates without a historical membership identity remain explicitly unverified
config.universe_discrepancy: Use retained original membership; flag inconsistent declared/stored counts, do not repair or silently drop the date
config.entry_exit: next XNYS session open to close of holding session 21
config.cost_model: full liquidation and re-entry each period; round-trip cost charged on planned invested notional, no netting
config.missingness: Keep unresolved selected weights; report observed-only means separately and fixed missing-return scenarios, never claim zero-imputation is an observed return
config.inference: Descriptive non-overlapping period comparisons; no significance or optimized parameter claims
config.prior_exposure: Same market dates as the first diagnostic; sample selected after seeing first-sample results using the predeclared next-300 rule, with no strategy tuning
